items.title: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
items.summary: Your AI Slop Bores Me is brilliant in its simplicity. There are two tabs: human and LARP as an AI. On one side you enter a request. On the other, you submit an answer. But the important thing is that there's a human on both sides of the equation.
